queries_run: AI GPU cloud compute shortage OR oversupply structural OR cyclical 2026 2027
AI data center power capacity new supply timeline GPU cloud 2027
AI infrastructure capex demand outlook 2027 2028 consensus hyperscaler

findings.claim: Goldman Sachs expects AI infrastructure supply and demand may not rebalance until 2028; its 2027 hyperscaler capex base case is about $1.1T (bull $1.4T).
findings.source: fourweekmba / kucoin blog summaries of Goldman Sachs (secondary)

findings.claim: Sell-side 2027 hyperscaler capex: Morgan Stanley $1.2T in 2027 (+30%) with $1.4T upside in 2028; UBS models capex growth slowing from 76% (2026) to 25% (2027) and 6% (2028).
findings.source: roic.ai Morgan Stanley / Goldman news pages; UBS via search summary (secondary)

findings.claim: Gartner (Nov 2024 forecast) predicts power shortages will restrict 40% of AI data centers by 2027; new grid capacity approvals reportedly take 24-36 months. Power is cited as binding constraint on new capacity.
findings.source: Data Center Knowledge: Power Shortages Will Restrict 40% of AI Data Centers By 2027 – Gartner

findings.claim: Spheron (GPU-cloud vendor) says GPU availability has improved over the past 18 months with neo-clouds and resellers offering H100/H200/Blackwell capacity; scarce input shifting from GPUs to grid connections. Vendor-biased source; no independent 2027 price forecast found.
findings.source: Spheron blog: AI data center power constraints 2026

findings.claim: CoreWeave backlog $99.4B at 2026-03-31 (vs $25.9B a year earlier); ~36% converts to revenue within 24 months, ~75% within four years; weighted average contract length about five years. Q1 2026 adjusted operating income $21M vs $163M a year earlier; adjusted net loss $589M; third-party data center delays accepted by customers with full contract value kept.
findings.source: Futurum: CoreWeave Q1 FY 2026 Capacity Constraints Amid Accelerating AI Demand; Nasdaq/Zacks summaries

supply_demand_durability.note: Search tool returned summaries not verbatim text, so excerpts null. as_of for Futurum (approx. mid-May 2026), Spheron (undated, approx.) and roic.ai items are approximations from URL/context. Industry framing sources are largely vendor or secondary.
